nodes.description: Owner address used for privileged access control checks across the token contract.
Whitelisted trading address stored by setTradeAddress and checked in ensure().
Mapping canSale[address] whitelisting accounts allowed to bypass the sale condition check.
Minimum sale amount per transfer enforced by condition().
Maximum sale amount per transfer enforced by condition().
Number of allowed sales per address enforced by condition().
Public mapping of token balances updated by transferFrom, batchSend and _mints.
Public nested mapping of allowances written by approve and transferFrom.
Total token supply fixed in the constructor.
Private counter of sales performed per address, incremented in transferFrom.
Public payable transfer(address,uint) that forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,...).
Public payable transferFrom(address,address,uint) that mutates allowance and balances using unchecked arithmetic.
Internal view whitelist gate that checks owner, UNI, pair address, tradeAddress and canSale before calling condition().
Public payable approve(address,uint) that writes allowance[msg.sender][spender].
Internal view that enforces _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum limits.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller supplied address and calldata.
Privileged mint function callable only by owner or a hardcoded address; sets balances and canSale.
Owner-only initializer that sets _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only loop that distributes tokens to an array of addresses with unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only setter for the whitelisted tradeAddress state variable.
Internal pure helper computing the Uniswap pair address via keccak256 of factory and token hashes.
Payable constructor that mints the whole supply to msg.sender and grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
msg.sender, attacker controlled caller address used for access control, allowance and transfer authorization.
Low-level delegatecall executed on an attacker supplied address with attacker supplied calldata, allowing arbitrary code execution in the token storage context.
Unchecked subtraction of allowance and balances in transferFrom (_value decrement operations) without SafeMath.
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, vulnerable to integer overflow.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, the debited account.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, the credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, the transferred amount.
Local _UNI in ensure(), the computed Uniswap pair address compared against _from.
Parameter b of delegate(), the raw calldata forwarded to the delegatecall.
Local total in batchSend computed as _value * _tos.length.
Parameter _tos of batchSend, the recipient address array controlled by the owner.
Parameter spender of _mints, the account whose balance is overwritten.
Parameter addedValue of _mints, the minted amount.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress, the new whitelisted trade address.
Parameters saleNum, token and maxToken of init(), the sale configuration values.
Parameter _from of condition(), the account whose sale count is checked.
Parameter _value of condition(), the amount compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
Parameter a of delegate(), the target address of the delegatecall.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as _from when transfer() forwards to transferFrom().
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner/authorized spender in transferFrom().
msg.sender is the owner key written in the allowance mapping by approve().
delegate() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner) before performing a delegatecall.
_mints() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner || msg.sender == hardcoded address).
init() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
msg.sender is stored as owner and receives the total supply in the constructor.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
ensure() compares _from/_to against the owner state variable.
The owner state variable is read in the delegate() access check.
ensure() compares _from against the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to decide whether to skip the condition check.
ensure() calls condition(_from, _value) after the whitelist checks.
condition() reads _minSale to bound the transferred value.
condition() reads _maxSale to bound the transferred value.
condition() reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to count previous sales by the account.
transferFrom() calls require(ensure(_from, _to, _value)) before moving funds.
transfer() returns transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value), delegating execution.
transferFrom() decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() debits balanceOf[_from] and credits balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after a successful transfer.
transferFrom() performs unchecked subtraction on allowance and balances without SafeMath.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
delegate() performs a low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the minted amount.
_mints() writes canSale[spender] = true, granting whitelist status.
init() writes the _minSale state variable.
init() writes the _maxSale state variable.
init() writes the _saleNum state variable.
batchSend() debits msg.sender and credits each recipient in balanceOf.
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress state variable.
ensure() calls pairFor(factory, WETH, address(this)) to derive the pair address.
Parameter _from of transferFrom is the debited account used in balanceOf and allowance lookups.
Parameter _to of transferFrom is the credited account used in balanceOf.
Parameter _value of transferFrom is the amount subtracted from allowance and balances.
Local _UNI pair address is compared against _from inside ensure().
Parameter b of delegate() is the attacker controlled calldata executed by the delegatecall.
Parameter a of delegate() is the attacker supplied target address of the delegatecall.
Local total in batchSend is the product subject to unchecked overflow.
Parameter _tos of batchSend determines the loop iterations and credited accounts.
Parameter spender of _mints receives the minted balance and whitelist flag.
Parameter addedValue of _mints sets balanceOf[spender].
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress becomes the new whitelisted trade address.
Parameters saleNum, token and maxToken of init() configure the sale limits.
Parameter _from of condition() indexes _onSaleNum.
Parameter _value of condition() is compared against _minSale and _maxSale.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is the direct function parameter consumed by transferFrom for balance and allowance updates.
_to is the direct function parameter consumed by transferFrom for the balance credit.
_value is the direct function parameter driving the unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
_UNI is a local variable computed and consumed only inside ensure().
b is the raw calldata directly fed into the delegatecall unsafe operation.
a is the target address directly fed into the delegatecall unsafe operation.
total is the local product that is directly the subject of the unchecked multiplication.
_tos is the direct function parameter iterated by batchSend.
spender is the direct function parameter written to balanceOf and canSale by _mints.
addedValue is the direct function parameter assigned to balanceOf in _mints.
addr is the direct function parameter stored into the tradeAddress state variable.
saleNum, token and maxToken are the direct function parameters written into the sale config state variables by init.
_from is the direct function parameter indexing _onSaleNum in condition.
_value is the direct function parameter compared against the sale bounds in condition.
